bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Follower is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve test to continue fighting.

bonuses.name: Animal
bonuses.text: A Cyber-Mastiff is unable to take any actions which would require the use of hands.

bonuses.name: Apprehend
bonuses.text: If an enemy becomes Restrained as a result of a Cyber-Mastiff’s attack, the condition remains while they are engaged with the Cyber-Mastiff—they are restrained by the Cyber-Mastiff’s jaws. If an enemy attempts to break free, the DN is equal to the Cyber-Mastiff’s Strength, and a failed skill test inflicts 1d3 Mortal Wounds.
